justification: The only common content is the depiction of a human figure: A is a single sculpted torso and head with modelled facial features and shoulders, while B shows tiny stick-like figures with outstretched limbs subordinate to a crowded field of boats with crewed hull-strokes and cup-mark clusters. Nothing about the form, relationships, arrangement or manner of rendering corresponds — one is a solitary volumetric body, the other a linear schematic multi-motif scene dominated by watercraft.
